mechanism: Mesalamine may inhibit valproate metabolism and increase valproate serum concentrations, while valproate may increase mesalamine levels; both drugs can cause gastrointestinal effects and rarely hepatotoxicity.
action: Monitor valproate serum levels and clinical efficacy; assess for signs of valproate toxicity (tremor, sedation, ataxia); consider alternative mesalamine formulations or increased monitoring of liver function tests.
